articles.summary: AOA Dx unveiled Follow the Exits: Why Women’s Health Is a Smart Bet in Healthcare at the 2026 J.P. Morgan Healthcare Conference, presenting the first comprehensive analysis of 25 years of realized exits in women’s health. The report documents more than $100B in disclosed exit value and demonstrates that women’s health is a scaled, durable healthcare sector with accelerating momentum across diagnostics, biopharma, and devices.
articles.title: AOA Dx Releases First-Ever Comprehensive Women’s Health Exit Analysis, Revealing $100B+ in Realized Value Over 25 Years
